NM 02  茶園  The farm

Meet Nanzan-en南山園

Our matcha grows on one family farm in Aichi, Japan. Three generations tend the same terraced hills, put the nets up by hand and pick the first young leaves of the year. We know the people, and they know ours.

Where
Aichi prefecture, Japan
Run by
Three generations, one family
Fields
14 hectares of terraces
Cultivars
Okumidori, Samidori, Asahi
Shade
21 days under black nets
Picked
Once a year, by hand, in May
